name: @defen.so/init
description: One command to install a production Web Application Firewall. Detects Node (Next.js / Express / Fastify), PHP (Laravel / Symfony), and Python (Django / FastAPI / Flask), installs the right Defenso SDK, wires the middleware, writes DEFENSO_TOKEN to .env. $0 to start. Fails open. Playground + MCP for Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf included.
